Ranza · docs/evidence/analytics-month · trial record

Analytics: a month explained from the screen

PARTIAL. The month report, its breakdowns and the day detail work and reconcile to the database for every case I exercised in a real browser against a real database. The exercise also found layout defects in the code as committed (the new month screen pushed the page wider than the viewport at 1024px and 800px, and figures were clipped); they are fixed in 5caa265 and re-verified. Not exercised, and therefore UNVERIFIED: Front Desk, Finance and Owner roles, dark mode, the loading skeleton and a server-error state in the browser, named Guests in the browser, the hosted staging database, pnpm test:browser, and query cost on a large Property. See sections 1 and 5.

2. Environment

Commit63ad1c7 (features) + 5caa265 (layout fixes) on feat/month-report; this record is committed after them. Not pushed when the evidence was taken.
Appnext dev --port 3100 from apps/operator-workspace (dev build, not production), http://localhost:3100
DatabaseLocal PostgreSQL in Docker, container ranza-month-report-postgres-1, port 54491, role ranza_app under row-level security. Never the shared 54322 and never a hosted database.
DataProperty Galata Rezidans (369cc8c5-a3b7-423d-b43b-14d8d3b62fe6), currency TRY, Europe/Istanbul, business-day cutoff 04:00, 67 Stays, 313 folio lines, 150 business-day closes. Seeded by throwaway SQL kept outside the repo; Sept 2026 has unit types room/suite/apartment, 4 Resident nights, an unpriced booking, a Stay with no Folio, one reversed room night and payments by cash, card and bank transfer.
Accountslane-manager@example.test (holds finance.manage_folio) · lane-housekeeping@example.test (does not). Both signed in through the real sign-in screen.
ClockCaptures span 2026-10-04 23:45 to 2026-10-05 12:40 (+03:00). The Property's business date was 2026-10-05 for every capture except 00-logged-out-redirect (Oct 4). The business date rolling over changed the "as of" text between runs; the figures for closed days did not change.
BrowserPlaywright-driven Chromium, viewport 1360×900 unless a width is named. Each screenshot is a real capture of the state its caption names; page text, HTTP status, console errors and horizontal overflow were read from the same page in the same step.

3.2 Opening a day

Interactive flow, driven by real clicks (state read after each step):

1  /analytics?month=2026-09                       no sheet                    focus: body
2  click row "9 Wed"  → ?day=2026-09-09           sheet "Wednesday, Sep 9"     focus: Close button
3  click "Next day: Thursday, Sep 10" → ?day=2026-09-10   sheet "Thursday, Sep 10" (replaced)
4  click Close                  → ?month=2026-09   no sheet                    focus: row "10 Thu"
5  click row "9 Wed" again                          sheet "Wednesday, Sep 9"
6  press Escape                 → ?month=2026-09   no sheet                    focus: row "9 Wed"
7  load ?month=2026-08 while a sheet was open      no sheet

3.3 Masking: Housekeeping, who lacks finance.manage_folio

What the server sent, not just what the screen showed. I fetched the raw page response (HTML plus the embedded server payload) as each user and searched it.

SearchManager (positive control)Housekeeping
Amounts 33066000, 32826000, 26614800, 330,660, 328,260, 266,148, 2,400.00, 3,282.60found (e.g. 26614800 ×2, 33066000 ×1)none found
Day-detail keys chargeMinor, correctionsMinor, grossMinorpresent (chargeMinor ×3, correctionsMinor ×2, grossMinor ×2)absent
Month-report fields adrMinor, revParMinor, collectedMinor, otherRevenueMinor, totalRevenueMinor, revenueBookedMinor, differenceMinor, roomRevenueMinorpresent with valuespresent as null only; a pattern for any non-null value matched nothing
Other matches in the masked response—translation labels (e.g. "roomRevenue":"Room Revenue", auditContext.amountMinor:"Amount", present on the Today page too) and the currency code "TRY", which is not an amount

The positive control matters: the same search finds the amounts for the manager, so a clean result for Housekeeping cannot be a search that finds nothing.

3.4 Languages and width

4. Before and after: the layout defects

“Before” is the committed code at 63ad1c7 (the four files reverted to that commit for the capture, then restored). “After” is 5caa265. Figures are measured in the page, not judged by eye.

Page · widthBefore (63ad1c7)After (5caa265)
Month Sept · 1024pxpage 1059px in a 1024px window; ADR and RevPAR clippedno overflow, nothing clipped
Month Sept · 800pxpage 909px in an 800px window; ADR and RevPAR clipped; unit-type table past the edgeno overflow (cards stack until 1024px)
Trailing 7d · 1360pxpage 1392px; five amounts clipped (TRY 20,400.00, TRY 2,914.29, TRY 425.00, TRY 20,400.00, TRY 24,720.00)none clipped; cards in two rows of three
Trailing 30d · 1024pxpage 1031px; payment row TRY 73,476.00 (32.0%) past the edgeno overflow

Sweeps after the fix. A scripted pass loaded each page at each width and measured page overflow and any clipped amount: month Sept, Oct, June, Arabic Sept, and trailing today/7d/30d at 1536, 1360, 1280, 1180, 1100, 1024, 900, 800, 640 and 400px. Sweeps on interim code reported failures twice (see F3). The sweep on the final code, 4 pages × 10 widths = 40 combinations, reported 0 page overflows, 0 clipped amounts and 0 numbers split across lines. An earlier 70-combination sweep that also passed ran on an interim fix and is not counted. Tables wider than the window sit inside their own scroll container, which is intended.

5. Behind the screen: tests and the defects the old query had

5.1 The five defects in the first version, reproduced on the old query

The new integration tests were run against the query as it was in f14e9d4 (before this work), by putting that file back in place, then restoring. The same tests then pass on the current code.

defect                                   test                                                   on the OLD query                                   on the CURRENT code
payments read negative                   payments_collected_read_positive_net_of_reversals      cashMinor -15000, expected 10000                   pass
inventory = today's unit count × days    unit_added_mid_month_counts_from_its_day               expected 14 to be 9                                pass
open day counted before it is charged    open_day_excluded_from_rates                           expected 5 to be 4                                 pass
correction dated by its own posting day  room_night_correction_counts_on_the_night_it_corrects  expected 32000 to be 42000                         pass
lines dated by a session-zone cast       report_dates_lines_with_app_business_date              expected 3000 to be 2000                           pass

Raw output from the old-query runs:

     × payments_collected_read_positive_net_of_reversals 37ms
     × unit_added_mid_month_counts_from_its_day 17ms
     × open_day_excluded_from_rates 16ms
     × room_night_correction_counts_on_the_night_it_corrects 15ms

AssertionError: expected 5 to be 4 // Object.is equality
AssertionError: expected 32000 to be 42000 // Object.is equality

TypeError: getMonthReport is not a function
     × report_dates_lines_with_app_business_date 39ms

Caveat on this table. A first run also listed other_revenue_dated_by_posting_business_date and posting_before_cutoff_belongs_to_the_working_day as failing on the old query; they failed with getMonthReport is not a function, which proves nothing about dates, so they are not counted. The date defect's real reproduction is the last row.

The open days (Oct 4 and 5) are in the October screen's day table but in none of its totals, which is why 24 available nights is three days' worth, not five.

7. Repro steps

cd ~/Developer/ranza-month-report            # branch feat/month-report
colima start; docker start ranza-month-report-postgres-1     # lane DB on 54491
set -a; source .env; set +a                  # DATABASE_URL points at 54491, never 54322
cd apps/operator-workspace
BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3100 npx next dev --port 3100
# sign in at http://localhost:3100/en/sign-in as lane-manager@example.test or lane-housekeeping@example.test
#   (password in the throwaway seed, not in the repo)
# manager:       /en/analytics?property=369cc8c5-a3b7-423d-b43b-14d8d3b62fe6&month=2026-09
#                ...&month=2026-09&day=2026-09-09        ...&month=2026-06        ...&range=7d
# Arabic / Turkish: replace /en/ with /ar/ or /tr/
# masked view:   the same URLs as lane-housekeeping
# raw payload:   fetch(url).then(r=>r.text()) in the page, then search for 26614800 and chargeMinor
cd ../..; pnpm check
npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.mts tests/integration/analytics.test.ts
node scripts/edge-cases-check.mjs

The seed data lives outside the repository, so reproducing the exact September figures needs the same seed; the integration suite builds its own fixtures and reproduces every rule on any local database.
